label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: On 2 Nov the Magento 2.4.9 upgrade (MT-1615) and the core upgrade (MT-1617) moved to UAT, together with most of their module subtasks held by Naman Bapna, Parth and shubham kuchwar; 42 MT items are now in UAT, which is not a Done status, so most stay past their 30 and 31 Oct dates. Naman Bapna closed the upgrade environment support (MT-1654) and started Part 2 of the upgrade (MT-1753, due 16 Nov). Shashi Prasad K raised a Highest-priority Go-Live checklist for 15 November (MT-1770, Naman Bapna, due 13 Nov) with checks for the request-for-quote, send-a-quote, invoice, product content, AI chatbot and Communication Hub flows (MT-1772 to MT-1777, due 4 to 5 Nov; Communication Hub has no date). Nagamuni Valluri closed the invalid order dates fix (MT-1757) and moved the GraphQL 403 and wishlist fixes to Ready For Prod (MT-1754, MT-1760); the chatbot RFQ redirect (MT-1761) is also Ready For Prod. The V1.4 design implementation (MT-1747) and three of its front-end subtasks started (MT-1763, MT-1765, MT-1768). 56 items are past due, down from 57.
